items.text: Fixed several issues causing players to be left behind their boat, fall asleep, or have boats sink when arriving on a new server, and corrected entities being taken from the wrong server or duplicated vehicles during transfers.
Enabled players to exit a vehicle and cross between seamless servers, and added full neighbor connections, server links, vehicle transfers, and client neighbor handling for seamless travel.
Rewrote the conveyor system to transfer a fixed amount of items per tick, sped up ticks when outputs are near full, and fixed conveyors not resuming scans after multi‑tick transfers.
Corrected the stacking behavior for AK rifles so a stack now correctly shows 20 AKs instead of an erroneous "20x AKs" label.
Added Minicopter wrecks that spawn at monuments (2 per map) which can be repaired for 10 gears, 400 metal fragments, 40 high‑quality metal and a random tier‑2 modular car part.
Added BoatDockTrigger to all fishing village variants; vehicles parked in vendor water docks are no longer stuck at the edges and are gently pulled to the centre.
Implemented customizable arrow skins with player‑name labels and configurable fletching colours; customisations persist after shooting and can be cleared via a station.
Added a toggle to keep mouse sensitivity consistent across all weapons.
Added an ammo indicator to the 40 mm Flashbang grenade.
Fixed a UI bug where powered storage adaptors incorrectly displayed “Requires power to sort”.

Major gameplay expansion for the experimental Rust XCOM mode: weapons now use proper hand bones and hold animations, walking chickens, bandit raids, ladder hatches, swinging doors, manual furnace at game speed, full armoury with loadouts, rock melee, overwatch mechanics, research and crafting systems, beds, hatches, exit ramps, chopping, hunting, terrain changes, camera controls, firing/death animations, cover fixes, holographic tiles, loot drops, persistent squads, food buffs, clan tables, patrols, dedicated music, resource economy, repeatable raids with loot, battle camera, combat callouts, building grades, tree placement, above‑ground base construction from Rust pieces, tiered upgrades (twig → metal), forest clearing, and a new Oxum mission scene with baked monument.
Fixed a NullReferenceException in WireTool.ShowSavedWire, preventing crashes or missing wire previews when using the Wire Tool.

items.text: Fixed terrain clipping in Nuclear Missile Silo doorways and underground tunnels, preventing doors from being blocked by terrain.
Encryption level is now applied on the network thread, preventing premature encryption setup and ensuring packet batches are flushed before sending, reducing connection errors.
DirectDraw objects no longer render when attached to entities that haven’t been networked to the client yet, fixing visual glitches.

2026-11-07.summary:
### Monuments & World
- Fixed terrain clipping in Nuclear Missile Silo doorways and underground tunnels, preventing doors from being blocked by terrain.

### Bug Fixes
- Encryption level is now applied on the network thread, preventing premature encryption setup and ensuring packet batches are flushed before sending, reducing connection errors.
- DirectDraw objects no longer render when attached to entities that haven’t been networked to the client yet, fixing visual glitches.
